It is also observed that the Petitioner filed online application on 16.5.2018 for issue of CEA energization certificate for the MahanSipat Transmission Line and CEA inspected the same on 23.5.2018 and 31.7.2018 and granted Approval for Energisation on 13.9.2018. As the Petitioner filed the application for approval of energisation on 16.5.2018, we are of the view that all the RoW issues were resolved by 16.5.2018.
